description: Defines the HeaderFooter class representing header or footer objects in a document, including methods for adding elements and serialization.

classes.name: HeaderFooter
classes.description: Represents a header or footer in a document, providing methods to add content and serialize the object.

classes.name: HeaderFooter.HeaderFooterValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for HeaderFooter.

methods.name: HeaderFooter.Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the HeaderFooter object.

methods.name: HeaderFooter.AddParagraph
methods.description: Adds a new paragraph to the header or footer.

methods.name: HeaderFooter.AddChart
methods.description: Adds a new chart with specified type to the header or footer.

methods.name: HeaderFooter.AddTable
methods.description: Adds a new table to the header or footer.

methods.name: HeaderFooter.AddImage
methods.description: Adds a new image to the header or footer.

methods.name: HeaderFooter.AddTextFrame
methods.description: Adds a new text frame to the header or footer.

methods.name: HeaderFooter.Add
methods.description: Adds an existing Paragraph, Chart, Table, Image, or TextFrame to the header or footer.

methods.name: HeaderFooter.Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the HeaderFooter object into DDL format.

methods.name: HeaderFooter.AcceptVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for traversing the object and its children.
